overview: Before the comedy you had Ferdinand's name at the head of the part, and the paper crown beside it. You did not copy a speech. The afternoon was the play, and the play is not on this page.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Kept the heading and the crown, and did not copy a speech.
